notes.title: v1.14 Out Now
notes.content:
Version 1.14 contains the following additions and changes:

[list]
[*] Fixed some spell hover texts that were missing, concerning Meteor, Nurture, Energy Well, Specters and Spikes and Sunspot!
[*] Meteor now causes fire or earth damage, it is random!
[*] Added new skills Light Bonus, Dark Bonus, Nature Bonus and Ice Bonus to provide boosts to the new spells.
[*] The monster power called Dent Armor has been changed so that the effects are more potent. This power will lower your armor value for up to 20seconds, making you easier to damage.
[*] From level 2 onwards if you are running out of energy you will find you auto-use food in your inventory (not limited to power bar) and don`t have to manually use it.
[*] Using items from your inventory and even the auto-food use feature now show an animated icon to represent the item that was used.
[*] Changed the behavior of the Swords and Daggers skills. These now provide a random additional attack versus an additional damage bonus.
[/list]

notes.title: v1.12 has been released!
notes.content:
NOTE: This patch only applies to the full release version and not the demo version.

It contains the following:

[list]
[*]Mimic monsters may now spawn in a select few locations.
[*]Opal Charged Birthstone effect has been changed, you now get full fly time plus a 10 second fly time buff for 60 seconds.
[*]Consuming any kind of potion now gives an empty bottle at the end of it.
[*]Empty bottles are a crafting ingredient for Alchemy and needed to craft potions.
[*]Expanded crafting to allow for a third ingredient when crafting.
[*]When using a shovel, if you have unlocked the Lair of Mushy you'll end up there instead of the Lost Tunnels when the teleport triggers.
[/list]

The change to potions is essentially to make it slightly more realistic but to also show you how recycling works!

notes.title: Patch v1.11
notes.content:
This is a stability patch providing numerous fixes, including:

[list]
[*] Inventory Quantity and Power Quantity Stacking Glitch that may have meant the amount of items in your inventory was out of sync with your Power Bar Quantity.
[*] Energy Well may have been glitched for some and could not be picked up off the ground when it drops.
[*] Corrected a couple of grammatical issues with some of the quest screens.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch v1.07 out now!
notes.content:
Patch v1.07 adds the following features and changes:

[list]
[*] Added a Statistics button to the Achievements screen to allow you to see additional metrics that were previously hidden.
[*] Iridium armor is now visible as a crafting item when you go above level 7, previously it hid but as you need Iridium to make Stone armor it makes no sense for that to continue.
[*] Crafted (i.e. the number of times you crafted an item) is now recorded as a metric.
[*] Clicking on your Birthstone or Cataclysm on the Character screen will now repeat the text you saw when you were assigned that item.
[*] Birthstone powers now kick in more frequently.
[*] Completely redesigned the lighting system, lighting should now be a lot prettier.
[*] ESC key now triggers the game menu as well as the ~ key.
[*] Fixed and issue where the Change Log and Options menu items from the in-game menu may not have been selectable from keyboard or controller.
[*] Window Transparency setting in options has been replaced with Glow Effect, this option allows you to minimize the complexity of the glow bubbles for lighting. Setting it to reduced will improve performance.
[*] Added level 8+ combat power called Meteor.
[*] When a controller is in use (or on SteamDeck) the circle buttons will show the tooltip text on the button, it`s dawned on me that tooltip text will never show up when using a controller and some of those buttons were vague one word or even a symbol before, so the tooltip text was important.
[/list]

notes.title: v1.04 with some more helpers added!
notes.content:
Here are the following changes for v1.04.

[list]
[*] The Auto NPC option in Options now defaults to on, you can change it to off if you don`t like this behavior.
[*] Tweaked the outline effect when selecting an NPC or object, performance has improved because of it.
[*] Changed the baked on text system, to show the relevant and related key or button press above it. This is more intuitive.
[*] Added a ton more baked on text helper tips in the Inn, Frontiersville and the Elder Forest. These go away after level 1 and are solely designed to give new players a helping hand.
[/list]

notes.title: Lots of changes added to v1.01
notes.content:
Here's just part of the changes made to this version, ahead of the launch on June 26th.

[list]
[*] Tab key now toggles Story mode on and off. Much more than hiding the HUD, this feature also hides tool tips and a few other things so you can play with all the clutter off. You can also take great screenshots and videos this way.
[*] Fixed a bug with the loading screen that meant if you resized the window using F11 the position of the loading elements may have been incorrect.
[*] Improvements have been made to the Cursedlands Map.
[*] Fixed a bug with the Family Stone effect, causing active map filters to drop off.
[*] Added a short tip area to the load screen. Each time you load the game you'll cycle through the available tips, until it runs out and starts over.
[*] Tweaked some of the Crypts content.
[*] Footprints in the snow was added in this patch. You can turn this feature off in Options.
[*] R key now opens a Quick Use screen, allowing you to use any of your usable items in your inventory.
[*] New visual effect when gaining or losing bounty and when gaining or losing coins.
[*] Hiring an NPC now correctly closes the NPC window.
[*] Added a flying hint tip to Elder Forest.
[*] Some NPCs now have little blurbs of text to say as you walk past.
[*] Speech bubbles now activate with a lighting effect to make them easier to read in the dark.
[*] Monsters 2 levels lower than your own level will now reset to neutral status and not attack you. Your combat pet will not be able to start a fight with these by default, so you'd have to land the first blow.
[/list]

notes.title: v0.99 Now Live
notes.content:
Here are the latest changes:

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with the new key/button icons not showing up over a power slot if nothing is readied at that slot.
[*] Fixed an issue with the newly changed Powers screen that may have led to an error when hovering the mouse over an unused power.
[*] Shortcut icons now show up on top of the CIRCLE buttons, indicating what controller button/key press triggers the button. The Trigger Key tooltip text has been removed.
[*] The final choice screen now works correctly with Controllers.
[*] Using the WASD keys to select items on sub-screens is no longer quite as twitchy.
[*] Modified button layout for the Inventory screen popups so that Use is always on the left side, Drop on the right etc...
[*] Circle button transparency added as an option to the Options screen, so you can tweak how solid or transparent they are.
[*] Loot drops from monster kills no longer slide away from you, it's more of a drop on the spot so you can gather them more easily.
[*] Added a new random loot drop ability called Nurture, which heals 20% of your health every 8 seconds for up to 60 seconds, depending on your level.
[*] Added a new boss Sigil, this is another raid boss that is available solely from the Courtyard at Sanctum.
[*] Added a Treasure Box to Sanctum that contains rewards for defeating the Raid Bosses.
[*] Added a new Outfit feature, with 3 additional outfit choices. These must be unlocked through acquiring the following items, Royal Crown (royal outfit), Top Hat (patriot outfit), Party Mask (party outfit).
[*] Added a new Backpack item that allows you to expand your inventory storage capacity.
[*] The Level Cap for the DEMO has been dropped from level 4 to level 3.
[/list]

notes.title: v0.96 with Controller Support has been released!
notes.content:
Great news, today is the first release that features Controller support.

And the following other changes:

[list]
[*] Apparition, Beholder, Tusker and a few more critters now have enhanced combat abilities.
[*] The Cook in BAC Base is now Giftable and has combat abilities when Hanging Out.
[*] Added some additional sound effects to some of the new monster abilities.
[*] Fixed a bug with Darkness/Illumination that may have caused your shadow to disappear.
[*] Added auto-select NPC as an option, default is OFF. You can turn it on and as you get near NPCs it will automatically select them. Overwritten to ON when a Controller is in use.
[*] The RED X icon that was visible on some windows prior, has now been removed the new X circle button should work across all screens in conjunction with the X key or similar controller button.
[*] The MAP screen is now up and running with Keyboard support use the < and > keys to switch between selected points and the space key to travel.
[*] Switching between light and dark is no longer quite as stark and abrupt and is now a slightly more subtle transformation.
[*] Important things like teleporters, doors etc now show up brighter.
[*] Gift button has been removed from some NPCs that were part of the Fight or Capture group.
[/list]

notes.title: v0.94 Now Ready for you to enjoy!
notes.content:
Quite a long list of changes and additions in this release as we get nearer to the final build.

[b]Additions[/b]

[list]
[*] Jumping with pets out now shows their jump animation as well.
[*] NPC buttons may now have additional requirements to work in some situations.
[*] All the NPCs in Frontiersville that can be given gifts now have the GIFT button. All other NPCs which are not giftable do not have the button.
[*] Hang Out NPCs have now largely been given combat abilities.
[*] As well as yielding fungus when digging, you may accidentally fall into the Lost Tunnels. Who knows what awaits below?
[*[ A new combat power called Spores has been added. Who knows where you get it? Who is paying attention?
[*] The brown error popup window has been replaced with a more subtle icon that will display just below your avatar and flash if an error was triggered. Clicking the flashy stick of dynamite will show the error reporting tool.
[*] Adjusting difficulty no longer requires changing maps for monsters to scale to the new difficulty setting. It's all done dynamically so you will see the change in stats immediately.
[*] Tooltip Pics option added to the Options screen. This setting toggles the use of the new key press and mouse button icons on tooltips. By default you see those up to level 3. With this setting you can turn it off prior to level 3 if it becomes annoying.
[*] Runebags are now a drop item, they happen when Illumination is in effect. Runebags give runes upon use. A rune can be fitted into an equipped item using the Hammer an the T key.
[*] Any time you gain an item and you are above level 3 and the item can be enchanted there is a chance (30%) it will start with a random 5% effect applied to it already. This is quite low, you'd do better to use the Hammer and add something to it but it's better than nothing.
[*] Runestones are an ancient thing and as such they stand a chance to disintegrate randomly, when this happens you'll gain ancient dust in your inventory and lose some runestones.
[/list]

[b]Fixes[/b]

[list]
[*] Wing Jumping is back in after getting a fix.
[*] Fixed a bug that repeatedly smacking space key with a resource node selected may have caused an error when the node was consumed fully.
[*] Fixed a bug that may have caused an error when traveling to a new map if a new area effect had triggered just as you were leaving the old map.
[/list]

notes.title: v0.92 Released for All Builds
notes.content:
Good things come to those who wait! At least that's what the vibe is with this patch.

Included in this version, just about everything but the kitchen sink (although there is now a kitchen sink in the kitchen of the Inn).

[list]
[*] NPCs now react to certain scenarios making them like you or not. An NPC that likes you may give you store discounts, extra quests and more. - See the new GIFT button on some NPCS.
[*] Fixed another issue with Save and Exit that may have caused your save file to get deleted.
[*] The Switch Character screen now also lists characters that only exist in backup form, allowing you to restore your character without going to the backup screen. Although the backup screen allows restoring backups of all characters, while the Switch restore function is solely for characters that only exist as a backup.
[*] Created a workaround for an issue where the last character you played no longer exists may have caused the switch function to not load.
[*] Fixed an issue with some item descriptions containing slash characters.
[*] Fixed a bug that may have made a pet take combat focus for abilities and combat quit working.
[*] Added additional combat animations, new visual effects for Sunspot, Decay and Shard and more .... complete revamp of all power visual effects.
[*] When logging in, if you had meat and other raw products there is a chance that some of them may rot. This reduces your held items but also adds a festering fungus in exchange.
[*] Fixed clicking on a power slot for an item with a single charge will no longer cause you to move when you click and the charge is consumed.
[*] Some items now have new item images.
[/list]

notes.title: v0.87 Cosmetic and Gameplay Changes
notes.content:
The following changes have been applied to v0.87.

[list]
[*] A change to the way monster damage is displayed on screen has been added. Damage totals are now grouped together when you use a power, so you know exactly what kind of damage your powers put out.
[*] The Map (M) screen now shows you a running total of how many maps you have unlocked.
[*] Combat damage/effect messages now display above the lighting layer so they can be read easily day or night
[*] Ability range circle now draws above the lighting layer so you can see it more easily.
[*] Fixed an issue with spells not auto-targeting a monster if nothing was selected and the monster did not bump into you.
[*] New commands, the < key now targets and attempts to move to the nearest monster to the left of the player, while the > key attempts to select and move to the nearest monster to the right.
[/list]

notes.title: v0.83 Performance Update and Fixes
notes.content:
A larger update than most, this contains a number of patches and bug fixes.

[list]
[*] Holding down Shift key while taking a screenshot with F7 / F8 will disable darkness allowing for a much brighter image. Not holding down Shift will use the current lighting.
[*] F7 and F8 now work during the loading screen and main menus without having a character loaded. Enabling you to capture more of the game for whatever reason.
[*] Changed cleanup code for monster and map object clean up when exiting a map. In particular to resolve boulder traps not being properly destroyed.
[*] The Hair Dye item now presents a screen allowing you to pick a new hair color. There are more selections available than the Character Creation screen.
[*] The Storekeep at Frontiersville now also sells Skin Cream and an Eye Potion to allow you to change skin and eye coloring post character creation.
[*] Using TAB to turn HUD off now sticks and remains off if you change maps. Previously it may have turned back on.
[*] Various performance tweaks and changes to improve FPS in certain areas.
[*] New /commands /cpu and /gpu (default) switch between CPU and GPU rendering. Useful if GPU rendering is not running as fast as possible.
[*] Health and Energy regeneration no longer has a heart or pot fly from your character, there is now a more subtle animation
[/list]

notes.title: v0.8 More Sanctum Content
notes.content:
Once you gain access to your Sanctum you will notice it is in a state of disrepair.

While you can choose not to repair it, and live in it with the draughts and everything you can also choose to repair it.

[*] Sanctum Level 2: Guards return to the Sanctum, these NPCs may have quests for you to take.

[*] Sanctum Level 2: Cracks on some levels are repaired.
[*] Sanctum Level 3: Additional Guards return to the sanctum.
[*] Sanctum Level 3: All cracks are repaired.
[*] Sanctum Level 3: A new NPC shows up that can be hired to act as your combat pet with ties back to your family.
[*] Sanctum Level 4: The exterior image seen in the Dark Grove/Stone Haven map is updated to a new one showing all of the repairs that have been made.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.77 with Pilfering Added
notes.content:
Today sees the implementation of patch 0.77 which includes the new Pilfering ability.

[b]What is Pilfering?[/b]
Good Question, it is the art of stealing from an NPC. Please note PILFERING raises your bounty, so is only intended for folks that like to embrace being naughty/criminal.

[b]How to Pilfer?[/b]
Stealth, stand next to an NPC, click/select the NPC and click SPACE.

You'll receive either a random item, some money or a chest (rare chance). If you fail you may be unstealthed.

Also added to this patch:

[list]
[*] Some interface sound effects now play at 30% of your Effect volume level.
[*] Added Timid Tim and the Back Alley Club to the Alley behind Frontiersville.
[*] Added a fix to prevent the secondary pet from not loading correctly due to a scaling issue.
[*] The Quest Journal now groups Complete and Incomplete quests together, with Incomplete quests shown first. This makes it easier to find a quest you are working on.
[/list]

notes.title: v0.75 Sound Effect Improvement Patch Part 1
notes.content:
Todays patch includes a number of improvements to the way sounds work in game. In particular regard to NPCs and interacting with NPCs.

A number of the NPCS were previously scripted with a generic series of sound effects which gets repetitive. Work is ongoing to update these to be a little more enjoyable.

A number of monsters have also had new sound effects added as all too often I simply went with "Bear" attack noises .... lazy but this is why the game is currently going through early access to iron out these last few kinks.

Speaking of kinks, a glitch which caused male players to use the female voice has been fixed.

Please note this is simply Part 1 of a series of patches to correct the sound effects.
